snippet.title: Shade of the Marionette | Piyorita Awakens – Official Teaser
snippet.description:
The Steam page for Shade of the Marionette is now live!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5034390/Shade_of_the_Marionette/
🎮 Add it to your wishlist now!

In the white Nest, #Piyorita opens her eyes for the first time.
Her journey to become the one and only Masterpiece begins—

A new 3D story-driven action RPG set in the world of WitchSpring
Coming to PC and consoles in 2027
